draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Yercaud! This hill station sits at 1,515 m in the Servarayan Hills, and its Big Lake is said to be the only natural lake among all the hill station lakes in the South.
draft.hungryLine: Head near the lake for a simple, tasty Chettinad meal with soft chappathis.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Start at Yercaud Lake, then take the steep road north from the centre of town to Arthur Seat, 1 km away, for a bird's eye view of the lake and Shevaroyan Peak. Holy Trinity Church is a 21 min walk from here.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Rent a rowing or pedal boat on Yercaud Lake, or rest in Anna Park next door and wander its Japanese Park.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Bell Rock, on the BSI campus, makes a bell sound when you hit it with a stone.

spots.name: Yercaud Lake
spots.detail: In town · Also called the Big Lake or Emerald Lake, with boating and a floating fountain

spots.name: Arthur Seat
spots.detail: 1 km from town · Viewpoint over the lake, town and Shevaroyan Peak

spots.name: Holy Trinity Church
spots.detail: 21 min walk · Built in 1834, with the memorial of the 'Father of Indian Prehistory'

tips.title: Come in May for the flowers.
tips.body: Anna Park, beside the lake, hosts the Flower Show in May.

tips.title: Skip Bell Rock on Sundays.
tips.body: It's closed on Sundays and national holidays, so plan that climb for another day.

story.title: Ancient tools
story.body: Stone-age implements have been found near an ancient shrine in the Servarayan Hills. It's about 5 km from Yercaud lake.

story.title: Coffee and citrus
story.body: M. D. Cockburn, the Salem collector, helped set up coffee plantations here. Citrus saplings were brought in from South Africa too.

story.title: Holy Trinity Church
story.body: The church was built in 1834 and rebuilt in 1853 after a damaging accident. Missionary Peter Percival is buried here, and his son-in-law Robert Bruce Foote is remembered with a memorial.

story.title: Hill retreat
story.body: Yercaud has around 11,582 people as of 2011. Its highest point is the Servarayan temple at 1,628 m.

food.name: Karuppiah's Chettinad Mess
food.detail: Near the lake, known for tasty chappathis

food.name: Waterfront Restaurant
food.detail: A meal with a view, right opposite the lake
